== Summary ==
[[Coruscant (expansion)]] regular (silver ring) expansion symbol, used by [[Template:Set icon]] on card infoboxes. Transparent background, 160 × 160 px. Publisher: [[Decipher]].

== Method ==
Built from real Decipher print scans, not redrawn (swccg-guild/work#584):
* Each scan's symbol was centred on its ring and rotated to match the others, then a per-pixel median was taken across the stack to remove print and scan noise.
* The inner symbol is the median of all 18 scans below; the silver ring band is the median of the Light Side regular scans.
* One white-balance gain per set matches the silver ring's hue to Decipher's own decipher.com card images. Brightness was not changed and no contrast or saturation was added.
* Clean circular cut at the ring's outer edge.
